## Answer

**C.** $\displaystyle \frac{3\pi}{2}$.

Let

$$g(x,y)=\frac{\sqrt{f(x)}+2\sqrt{f(y)}}{\sqrt{f(x)}+\sqrt{f(y)}}.$$

The quarter-disk $D$ is symmetric under $x\leftrightarrow y$, and

$$g(x,y)+g(y,x)=3.$$

Therefore, if the required integral is $I$,

$$2I=\iint_D3\,dx\,dy=3\operatorname{area}(D)=3\pi,$$

so $I=3\pi/2$.
